# laravelcloud_cache (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud cache instance by ID. Useful when composing modules that reference a shared Valkey/Redis cache provisioned in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud cache instance by ID.

data "laravelcloud_cache" "shared_prd" {
  id = "cch_01HAM..."
}

output "shared_prd_cache_size" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_cache.shared_prd.size
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned cache ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of cache creation.
- `name` (String) Human-readable cache name.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the owning Cloud organisation.
- `region` (String) Deploy region.
- `size` (String) Cache size slug — e.g. `valkey-pro.1gb`.
- `status` (String) Cloud lifecycle status.
